mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, the temperature is 50 degrees with clear skies by the Verona Area High School. We are currently under a Waning Crescent moon.

Public Works is introducing a new leaf vacuum truck for the fall season. Residents are reminded that only loose leaves will be collected, so please avoid placing bagged leaves or debris on the curb. Additionally, if you are planning a residential project, check the latest city permits for sheds and detached garages.

There is plenty to do in our community. Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia are taking place today. Tomorrow, you can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, catch live music at Paddy Mac's, enjoy pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or test your wits at Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.

In the weekly report for the Verona Police Department, an officer arrested a 19-year-old Verona man on October 3. The individual was located in a vehicle with expired registration, and a stolen firearm was successfully recovered from the scene.
Today's delicious flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The restaurant is currently closed for the morning but will open today at 10:00 AM for all your cravings.
